title_zh: 挑选一幅装框的礼物画

scenario.goal_zh: 按收礼人喜好选定画作和边框颜色

context_zh: 顾客在画廊为姐姐挑选一幅小画，并比较画框。
author: author-phase03-c

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: I'm looking for a gift for my sister. She likes quiet city scenes.

sentences.speaker: Gallery Assistant Mei
sentences.text: This drawing of the old station might suit her. The artist drew it from the bridge.

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: I like that. Is it available without the gold frame?

sentences.speaker: Gallery Assistant Mei
sentences.text: Yes. We have a plain wooden frame, or you can buy the drawing on its own.

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: Could I see it with the wooden one? Her room has quite simple furniture.

sentences.speaker: Gallery Assistant Mei
sentences.text: Certainly. We can frame it here at the gallery and have it ready on Friday.

sentences.speaker: Arlo
sentences.text: That gives me enough time. I'll take it with the wooden frame, please.
